title: Build scoped Git Hub requests
responsibility: Provide repository-scoped API requests, exact ref resolution and base64 conversion.

inputs.name: exactRef.client
inputs.description: A repository-scoped transport used to request and resolve the supplied ref. Its repository and contents permission are set when the transport is created.

inputs.name: exactRef.ref
inputs.description: A full Git ref to resolve. It must use the heads, notes, or tags namespace and pass the ref and safe-path checks; exactRef rejects when it is missing.

inputs.name: githubTransport.options
inputs.description: Options supply the repository identity and scoped token callback used for requests, with an optional fetch implementation. Requests target that repository and request only its contents permission.

inputs.name: githubTransport.permission
inputs.description: The contents permission requested when obtaining a token for each request. Only read and write are accepted.

inputs.name: refPath.ref
inputs.description: A full ref in the refs/heads, refs/notes, or refs/tags namespace. It must pass the safe-path and Git ref character checks, including rejection of whitespace, dot-dot segments, and .lock path segments.

inputs.name: readRef.client
inputs.description: A repository-scoped transport whose request method reads the ref from GitHub. The transport determines the repository and contents permission used for that request.

inputs.name: readRef.ref
inputs.description: A full ref to look up in the heads, notes, or tags namespace. Notes use the matching-refs endpoint, and the result must contain exactly one entry with this exact ref.

inputs.name: base64.bytes
inputs.description: A Uint8Array whose byte values are converted to standard base64 text. Each element is encoded as one byte.

inputs.name: decode64.value
inputs.description: Base64 text to decode after all whitespace is removed. Content that atob cannot decode is rejected as invalid content.

outputs.name: githubTransport
outputs.description: An object exposing request and check methods, scoped to the configured repository and chosen contents permission. Requests reject invalid relative or dot-dot paths and redirects; explicitly accepted statuses return null data, while check validates repository identity and can require a private repository.

outputs.name: refPath
outputs.description: The API ref path after removing refs/ and URI-encoding each remaining segment. Only validated heads, notes, and tags refs are accepted.

outputs.name: readRef
outputs.description: The resolved object SHA for one exact ref, or null when the ref is absent (including an empty notes match). It rejects malformed responses or results without exactly one exact ref match.

outputs.name: exactRef
outputs.description: The resolved object SHA for one exact ref. Unlike readRef, it rejects when the ref is absent.

outputs.name: base64
outputs.description: Standard base64 text produced from the input bytes using btoa.

outputs.name: decode64
outputs.description: The bytes decoded from the whitespace-stripped base64 input. Invalid base64 content is rejected.

errors.name: CollaborationInputError
errors.description: The package's CollaborationInputError from fail (message 'Collaboration <code>', with a code property) represents the validation and request failures this transport exposes, including invalid refs or paths, invalid content, missing or non-unique exact refs, repository denial, and unavailable GitHub requests. readRef returns null for an ordinary missing ref, while exactRef rejects when its ref is absent.

inputs.name: exactRef.client
inputs.description: A repository-scoped transport used to request and resolve the supplied ref. Its repository and contents permission are set when the transport is created.

inputs.name: exactRef.ref
inputs.description: A full Git ref to resolve. It must use the heads, notes, or tags namespace and pass the ref and safe-path checks; exactRef rejects when it is missing.

outputs.name: exactRef
outputs.description: The resolved object SHA for one exact ref. Unlike readRef, it rejects when the ref is absent.

errors.name: CollaborationInputError
errors.description: Rejects with the package's CollaborationInputError from fail for invalid refs or paths, unavailable or malformed GitHub responses, mismatched ref results, or a missing exact ref. readRef itself returns null for an ordinary missing ref.

inputs.name: githubTransport.options
inputs.description: Options supply the repository identity and scoped token callback used for requests, with an optional fetch implementation. Requests target that repository and request only its contents permission.

inputs.name: githubTransport.permission
inputs.description: The contents permission requested when obtaining a token for each request. Only read and write are accepted.

outputs.name: githubTransport
outputs.description: An object exposing request and check methods, scoped to the configured repository and chosen contents permission. Requests reject invalid relative or dot-dot paths and redirects; explicitly accepted statuses return null data, while check validates repository identity and can require a private repository.

errors.name: CollaborationInputError
errors.description: The package's CollaborationInputError from fail is thrown when repository options fail validation or check detects a different repository ID or a public repository under privateOnly; request methods also throw it for invalid paths or unavailable GitHub requests. Repository validation can fail while creating the transport.

inputs.name: refPath.ref
inputs.description: A full ref in the refs/heads, refs/notes, or refs/tags namespace. It must pass the safe-path and Git ref character checks, including rejection of whitespace, dot-dot segments, and .lock path segments.

outputs.name: refPath
outputs.description: The API ref path after removing refs/ and URI-encoding each remaining segment. Only validated heads, notes, and tags refs are accepted.

errors.name: CollaborationInputError
errors.description: The package's CollaborationInputError from fail is thrown when the ref is outside the heads, notes, or tags namespaces or fails the safe-path or Git ref character checks.

inputs.name: readRef.client
inputs.description: A repository-scoped transport whose request method reads the ref from GitHub. The transport determines the repository and contents permission used for that request.

inputs.name: readRef.ref
inputs.description: A full ref to look up in the heads, notes, or tags namespace. Notes use the matching-refs endpoint, and the result must contain exactly one entry with this exact ref.

outputs.name: readRef
outputs.description: The resolved object SHA for one exact ref, or null when the ref is absent (including an empty notes match). It rejects malformed responses or results without exactly one exact ref match.

errors.name: CollaborationInputError
errors.description: Rejects with the package's CollaborationInputError from fail for invalid refs or paths, unavailable or malformed GitHub responses, or results without exactly one exact ref match. A 404 or an empty notes match returns null.

inputs.name: base64.bytes
inputs.description: A Uint8Array whose byte values are converted to standard base64 text. Each element is encoded as one byte.

outputs.name: base64
outputs.description: Standard base64 text produced from the input bytes using btoa.

inputs.name: decode64.value
inputs.description: Base64 text to decode after all whitespace is removed. Content that atob cannot decode is rejected as invalid content.

outputs.name: decode64
outputs.description: The bytes decoded from the whitespace-stripped base64 input. Invalid base64 content is rejected.

errors.name: CollaborationInputError
errors.description: The package's CollaborationInputError from fail is thrown when the whitespace-stripped input cannot be decoded as base64.
